records.name: Clay four-dimensional Yang-Mills existence and physical mass gap
records.quantifiers: for every compact simple gauge group G
records.normalization: WP00 physical Hamiltonian, vacuum, local gauge-invariant observables, and UV-concordance lock
hypotheses: axiomatic profile at least as strong as the cited Wightman and Osterwalder-Schrader schemes
records.conclusion: A nontrivial continuum quantum Yang-Mills theory exists and its physical Hamiltonian has a strictly positive finite gap above the vacuum.
records.source_locator: Clay status page and Jaffe-Witten official problem statement
records.claim_boundary: No WP01 or WP02 artifact proves any part of the terminal conjunction beyond source normalization.
residual_hypotheses: all YM-E and YM-M obligations from WP00

records.name: Reflection positivity and transfer matrix for lattice gauge approximations

records.source_locator: article abstract and theorem body required per-use for exact action and boundary conditions
records.claim_boundary: A transfer matrix at fixed lattice spacing is not the continuum physical Hamiltonian.
residual_hypotheses: OS reconstruction of the limiting theory

records.name: Strong-coupling infinite-volume lattice mass gap via functional inequalities
